[SWS_CM_10076]
⌈
A array shall be serialized as the concatenation of the following
elements:
• the length indicator which holds the length (in bytes) of the following array
• the array which contains the serialized elements of the array
where the size of the length field shall be determined as specified by ApSomeip-
TransformationProps.sizeOfArrayLengthField which applies to the array
⌋
